introHtml: Toys, games, and party favors with a built-in handle are easier to carry and hand out at events, making them ideal for trade shows, corporate picnics, and holiday giveaways. The handle adds convenience for recipients and extra branding space for your logo. Whether you choose a classic paddle ball game or a colorful bubble wand, the handle ensures your promotional item stays top of mind—and top of hand.
